thread:
reece: quick smoke for v8.0-int4 bring-up (onboard cohort: instr-follow + longseq). tl;dr first, details after.
nina: TL;DR pls
reece: p50=46ms p95=190ms. cost ~=0.36x fp16. global-concordance delta = -0.55% (n=6.8k). instruction-follow slice delta = -1.7% (n=1.3k), CI [-2.3%,-1.1%], p=0.009. longseq slice delta = -1.0% (n=2k).
ops-bot: Policy lookup: canary.policy.v2 -> slice_threshold=-0.015, global_threshold=-0.008, min_samples=1000, require_pvalue<0.05.
nina: so instruction-follow -1.7% exceeds slice_threshold and p<0.05 -> auto-fallback should apply. did it?
eval-bot: Canary run metrics: {"instr_follow_delta":-0.017, "global_concordance_delta":-0.005}. Metric keys: instr_follow present.
reece: weirdly routing didn't auto-rollback; some traffic (~1.5%) still hit canary for ~10m before we noticed.
nina: any runtime skew? tokenization?
reece: looking at diffs: v8.0 onboard included a minor tokenizer normalization: "NFKC + desktop emoji mapping" to reduce token growth. That changed token boundaries for some instructional prompts (prefix alignment shift). The quant int4 kernels then produced slightly different attention for shifted positions.
nina: so it's an interaction: tokenizer change -> token alignment shift -> quantized attention less robust -> slice drop.
eval-bot: sample counts: instr-follow 1300, longseq 2000. bootstrap CI for instr-follow as above. p-value 0.009.
reece: I also noticed the canary preflight validates model artifact hash and param counts, but not tokenizer parity. model-catalog onboarding step omitted tokenizer-version assert.
nina: plan: 1) immediate pause on promotion 2) rollback route if necessary 3) pin tokenizer to baseline tokenizer-v2 for canary hosts 4) run focused 3k stratified instr-follow eval with tokenizer-v2 5) add preflight tokenizer parity assert.
reece: executing rollback: `/rollout rollback --model v8.0-int4 --reason "instr-follow slice -1.7% exceeded slice_threshold; tokenizer mismatch suspected"`
ops-bot: Rollout command acknowledged. Started drain and switched route tag->v7.9 within 90s.
nina: confirm artifact ids?
reece: artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/1794519999/v8.0-int4-smoke-6.8k.jsonl. traces: https://redwood.internal/evals/1794519999/traces.zip
eval-bot: created incident INC-2026-0666 (auto-fallback candidate). Assigned: reece, nina. SLA: 72h.
nina: immediate patch: I'll add tokenizer-version field to model-metadata and a preflight check in canary-controller that fails if tokenizer differs from catalog baseline. small PR inbound.
reece: also schedule a focused A/B: stratified instr-follow oversample n=3k with both tokenizers and the int4 vs fp16 variants. want to isolate tokenizer vs quant kernel effect.
nina: long-term: consider a canary gate that runs a token-level alignment diff (random 1k prompts) and flags >2% token-boundary diffs before traffic.
eval-bot: note: quick local repro with baseline tokenizer reduces instr-follow delta to -0.2%; with new tokenizer reproduces -1.6% consistent with canary.
nina: good repro. will merge preflight assert PR and re-run the stratified A/B tomorrow morning. postmortem if root cause confirmed.
reece: thanks all, will post top-50 failing prompts and kernel traces when uploaded. :thumbsup:
